results.title: Nigeria approves law allowing states to run their own police
results.snippet:
The resolution, which seeks to amend the constitution, now requires President Bola Tinubu's assent to become law. It also requires further federal and state legislation for state police to become operational.

The move comes amid persistent security crises across Nigeria, including banditry, mass kidnappings and communal violence, which the federal security forces have struggled to contain.

results.title: Nigeria moves closer to state police as all 36 assemblies approve constitutional amendment
results.snippet:
Nigeria has moved a major step towards decentralising its policing system after all 36 state legislatures approved a constitutional amendment seeking to establish state police services alongside the federal police.
